source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 февраля ст. ст. — «Мцц. дев Еннафы, Валентины и Павлы (308).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 februarie — «Sfânta Muceniță Valentina»

attestations.note: doxologia.ro keeps a second Romanian day for her, 18 iulie, «Sfânta Muceniță Valentina», where the calendar prints her beside a Paul and sends both to one shared life of two sentences: «Sfinții Pavel şi Valentina au suferit moarte martirică pentru Mântuitorul nostru Iisus Hristos, în anul 308, deoarece nu au vrut să jertfească idolilor.» The pair of names and the year 308 are those of the Caesarea martyrs of 10 februarie, so the 18 iulie lines are read as the same two and are recorded here as a note rather than as a second feast row; she does not render on 18 iulie. The 18 iulie page gives no place, no judge and no troparion, so nothing there settles the identification beyond the names and the year. Read 24 September 2026 at https://doxologia.ro/18-iulie and https://doxologia.ro/viata-sfintilor-mucenici-pavel-valentina.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιοι Ενναθά, Ουαλεντίνα και Παύλος»

attestations.note: The three share one page, with one distich for the two women and a second for Paul. The page gives no year; it names the governor Firmilian and the persecution in Palestine.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
